MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing gives me a practical way to insulate connections in the battery holder, relay, and PCB projects reflected in my history.",
    "The digital caliper would help me measure boards, components, and mounting dimensions, making it useful alongside my small electronics and assembly work."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heavy battery lugs and waterproof splice connectors involve wiring, but their cable sizes and intended uses do not match my small electronics projects.",
    "The three filament options assume a printing activity I have not shown, while the thick acrylic sheet requires a specific project I do not currently have.",
    "The casters fit a past interest, but I already selected a set; that connection does not give me a reason to buy another now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been stretched into an interest in almost any DIY supply, including printer filament.",
    "Shared words such as battery, wire, or measuring seem to matter too much when the actual size and purpose differ from my projects."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, small battery holder, relay, and PCB supplies point toward small component work, where compatible sizes and practical supporting tools matter.",
    "I need a concrete use before choosing a specialized supply; a related past purchase alone does not establish a current need or a need for replacements."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hands-on project interests but often missed the scale, specific purpose, and current need that determine what I would choose."
}
